Loop se kisi bhi number ki table ban jati hai:

```python
n = int(input('Kis number ki table? '))

```

range(1, 11) matlab 1 se 10 tak — har baar number ko guna karke print kar diya.

Jarvis, coding me loop kya hota hai

Loop matlab ek hi kaam ko baar-baar karna, bina baar-baar likhe.

Example: agar tumhe 1 se 100 tak ginati likhni ho, to 100 line likhne ki jagah loop 3 line me wahi kaam kar dega:

```python
for i in range(1, 101):
    print(i)
```

Jaise pankha ghoomta rehta hai jab tak band na karo — loop bhi shart tak chalta rehta hai.
Mujhe batao python me even odd kaise check kare

Number ko 2 se bhag karke dekho:

```python
n = int(input('Number dalo: '))
if n % 2 == 0:
    print(n, 'even hai')
else:
    print(n, 'odd hai')
```

% ka matlab hai remainder — 2 se bhag par remainder 0 aaya to even, warna odd.

Prime number wo hota hai jo sirf 1 aur khud se kata jata hai:

```python

        break
print('Prime hai' if prime else 'Prime nahi hai')
```

2 se lekar n-1 tak kisi se bhi kat gaya to prime nahi hai.

